profile.headline: Software Engineer | React | TypeScript | JavaScript | Express | Node
profile.summary:
As a technology-agnostic software engineer with a background in program management, soft skills like adaptability, creativity, and curiosity have served me well. I am a quick learner who enjoys experimenting with new technologies. My touchstone has always been innovating to determine efficient solutions to complex problems.

I build modern and responsive web applications using JavaScript (ES6+), Typescript, Vue, React, HTML, CSS, Node, Express, and MongoDB. Other skills include Redux, Pinia, SASS/SCSS, Tailwind CSS, NoSQL, GraphQL, REST APIs, Mongoose, Webpack, Vite, GitHub/GitLab/Git, ESLint, Prettier, MVC, OOP, ORM.

I am targeting web development-specific roles, including front end, where I can apply my skills and experience to solve complex problems and deliver value to users and stakeholders.

Portfolio: https://daniel-jkim.com
GitHub: https://github.com/danjkim21

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Planned and executed development of a user interface feature using Vue and TypeScript, enabling batch training of autonomous vehicles and streamlining integration workflows to reduce deployment setup time at customer sites
• Refactored front end data ingestion from polled requests to WebSockets, enabling real-time, more accurate tracking of inputs read by industrial controllers
• Owned a feature end-to-end, implementing front end functionality in collaboration with product and design teams, updating PostgreSQL tables and Kotlin API endpoints, and authoring engineering design documentation
positions.insights: Skills: Vue.js · TypeScript · JavaScript · Tailwind CSS · Kotlin

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led and executed front end development for a business development web application, meeting all product milestones and launching the application MVP with 7+ unique features within five months 
• Co-owned the deployment of an internal SPA product on AWS Amplify to integrate authentication, analytics, storage and GraphQL endpoints, streamlining critical tools and features for the engineering team 
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to gather user requirements, iterate on front end design and features, resulting in functional and accessible user interfaces
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · TypeScript · JavaScript · Redux.js · GraphQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Amazon Dynamodb · Ant Design

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Designed and built semantically structured full stack web applications using React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB 
•  Collaborated with a 6-engineer team to delegate tasks and implement agile methodologies like Scrum to build modern, responsive, and robust web applications using best practices
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · JavaScript · Express.js · Node.js · MongoDB

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
•  Created and launched 3+ custom full stack web applications and static websites for diverse clients in small and medium-sized organizations 
•  Engaged with clients proactively to evaluate project scope, timeline, and technical specifications, consistently achieving on-time and on-budget project deliveries
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · WordPress · HTML5 · Responsive Web Design

positions.title: Program Director
positions.description: • Built a product beta and managed the development of a global risk assessment tool that analyzes the emerging market for advanced nuclear technologies.

positions.title: Senior Program Associate
positions.description:
• Developed a global market risk assessment tool that analyzes and characterizes the emerging market for advanced nuclear technologies using business intelligence software. 
• Managed operations of the Washington office, including research coordination, strategic communications planning, grant writing, and personnel management. 
• Organized ten workshops that engaged multi-sectoral policy leaders and coalitions to develop actionable policy recommendations on the nexus of nuclear power, emerging technologies, climate change, and geopolitical issues.
• Spearheaded The Nuclear News bi-weekly publication, website and media content, and engagement with partner institutions and audiences.

positions.title: Research Assistant - Statistical Data Analysis
positions.description:
• Utilized advanced Excel functions and macros to manipulate and manage quantitative data sets of over 1,000,000 observations pertaining to confidential student testing scores and information across the United States.
• Lead a team responsible for administering data quality assurance and assisting with generating finalized student reports formatted to client specifications.
• Generated mock data sets to test the constraints and functionality of internally-developed database management software.

educations.fieldOfStudy: double major in International Affairs and Economics

projects.title: The Global America Business Institute
projects.description:
Optimized and rebuilt a modern and responsive static website with a CMS platform that displays the organization’s relevant reports, latest events, and research.

Tech used: HTML, CSS, JS, FTP, WordPress

projects.title: arDB (Advanced Reactor Database)
projects.description:
arDB is a full stack web application containing web scraped data of advanced nuclear reactor designs. Users can explore or call to a RESTful API containing scrapped data on advanced nuclear reactor technical specifications and information related to reactor dynamics, and electricity production.

Tech used: TypeScript, React, Node, Express, MongoDB, Cheerio, Puppeteer

publications.title: Geopolitical Competition and the Future of Nuclear Power
publications.publisher: Korean Journal of Nonproliferation and Nuclear Power · Dec 1, 2019
